summary:
Implemented and exported `Perc` with integer or explicit percentile levels, both orientations, missing-value exclusion, NumPy’s version-aware percentile keyword, and `GroupBy.apply` ordering. Added API documentation, examples, a v0.12.1 release note, and focused tests covering calculations, grouping, method selection, and `Plot.add`.

Focused tests passed (3/3). The full suite had 1 unrelated failure in `tests/test_axisgrid.py::TestFacetGrid::test_subplot_kws` due to the installed Matplotlib class name; 1,782 passed, 81 skipped, and 6 xfailed. Skipped a docs build; no other known risks.
